title: I’m developing a fully generative AI cooking game. The AI generates all sprites and logic. What ingredients should I add? (Literally anything is possible)
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
Built with Claude Code   
Logic - Gemini  
Sprites - Flux  
  
Try it out at: [https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen](https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen)

comments.author: lucaspedrajas
comments.body:
Maybe don't add more ingredients but introduce a separated mechanic to discover or purchase new ingredients,

Who is eating this food, you could have characters rating your dishes , increasing/ diminishing chef reputation , money or whatever  so you can access better ingredients ? Maybe all this is out of scope but you need to add something that feels like progression 

 I'm just working on something similar but for material and technology crafting , instead of having all the base materials at the beginning I can send my character to expeditions and equip him with tools to bring me different raw materials , everything is also generated

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body:
Its kinda fun playing with random stuff i guess I added a shoe for example.   
  
Once i get the cooking loop part of it working nicely, i am going to add a restaurant you run where you server dishes to make money, then use that to unlock new ingredients or tools.

comments.author: Revolutionary_Heart6
comments.body: very cool. the final dish was a bit underwhelming tho. i was expecting for the 3 ingridients to fuse into a dish and not just 3 things scattered separated on the plate. maybe work on that. the dish should look fuller at the end

comments.author: RelapseCatAddict
comments.body: Can you add Haggis as a dish to cook?

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body: I can add a few more raw ingredients and you can try create it from those.

comments.author: neryen
comments.body:
Should just open up a grochery store page.. and pull all the fresh fruits and veggies from the list.. add several types of fish meats like tuna, both canned and fresh...

Would likely exponentially increase your cooking materials and dishes.

Could also add baking to your tools, steaming, frying..

comments.author: d-czar
comments.body: Love it. Very smart simple way to use generative — it’s a good template for how AI game mechanics can work without feeling like they’re trying to do too much

replies.author: d-czar
replies.body: Bro, I’ve been using em’s since you were going wee in your sweater tights. Where do you think the AI learned it from?

comments.author: The-Doodle-Dude
comments.body: Can you make the onion have 2 level slices? Shouldn’t we be able to cut onion rings first before diced
